about: A word built from its parts: each part arrives as a tile with its meaning beneath, then the tiles slide together into the whole word with what it means: roots, prefixes and suffixes, compounds, how a term was made.

parts.about: the parts in order, split by |

meanings.about: what each part means, split by |

whole.about: what the whole word means, under it once joined

when.about: moments each part arrives, then the moment they join; else when they are said, or one after another
